blind.description: An ornate bronze and brass weathervane featuring a central vertical spindle topped with a spherical finial. The rotating top section consists of a stylized triangular arrow point on one side and a swallowtail banner/pennant with a diamond cutout on the opposite side. Below the rotating vane is an ornamental central sphere and a four-pointed cardinal directional cross tipped with small spheres, resting on a cylindrical collar base. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with metallic antiqued bronze patina and highlighted brass edges.
blind.from_above: A cross-shaped overhead profile showing the linear vane assembly (arrowhead pointing left, banner pointing right) centered over the spherical finial, with two small spherical-tipped directional arms extending perpendicular north and south.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 2.5 to 3 feet tall (about half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2 to 2.5 feet wide from arrowhead to banner tip.

notes: footprint proportion 1.52x off the catalog (3.5 x 1.4 ft)
